requirement: energy_mcp and mcpqa are separate distributions (energy-mcp, mcpqa), each with its own pyproject.toml, installed editable from their src folders in this repo.
mcpqa never imports or depends on energy_mcp: the reusable suite sees only what any MCP server exposes.
Installed versions equal the exact pins in requirements.txt, and the MCP SDK is 2.3.0 with the v2 API (MCPServer, Client) this plan is written against.

Traceability: every test cites a catalogued requirement, every catalogued requirement has a test, catalogue IDs are unique and well-formed, and docs/rtm.* is current (CRLF checkouts and BOM catalogues included).
CI runs the full suite on Ubuntu and Windows with Python 3.12, installs the exact pins, has read-only permissions and never references a secret; repo text files are LF.
